title: Saw for the Zombie
text:
Walkthrough

When you step on the button below, you will trigger a buzzsaw that is approaching. You have to slow down to make sure the crate lands ahead of you. Before the saw strikes the box, climb that box, then jump over the saw. That way, the brain parasite will be removed.

To escape, you have to retreat to the hanging platforms, then you will need to walk back and forth on the lowest platform, to allow it to swing up and down. This lets you gain the ability jump to the other platforms, and return to the elevator you passed.
